venues.name: JBJ's Nashville
venues.summary: Jon Bon Jovi's five-floor venue at 4th and Broadway: eight bars, three stages, two rooftops and the largest banquet kitchen on Lower Broadway. Built for everything from a 40-person rooftop reception to a full buyout for 1,700.
venues.description: Five floors of rock-and-roll energy with refined hospitality behind it. The two rooftop decks are the highest on Broadway, with downtown views and their own stages; balconies on the upper floors overlook the main stage, which is visible from three levels. The fourth floor holds the restaurant and quieter dining with Broadway views, and the Steel Horse Lounge offers reserved seating Thursday through Saturday. A full commercial banquet kitchen means custom menus, not a bar menu on plates. Three LED walls and 60-plus HDTVs handle branding and broadcasts; live bands and DJs are bookable through the house. 21 and over after 6pm Thursday to Saturday and after 8pm Sunday to Wednesday.
